items: 壁纸列表改为一张完整卡片并用分隔线区分条目，拖拽把手统一使用宿主公开样式 token，触控命中区保持 40px。
startup 轮换改为每次打开或重新加载 Web UI 会话时推进一次。
统一壁纸卡片与其他列表的纵向拖拽排序交互，拖拽把手保持卡片原位并支持触控操作。

en-US.description: Manage multiple custom wallpapers in NexusPipeline, including rotation, display effects, and adaptive colors.

items: Wallpaper entries now share one card with dividers, and the drag handle follows the host's public style tokens with a 40px touch target.
Startup rotation now advances once whenever a Web UI session opens or reloads.
Wallpaper cards now use the same vertical drag sorting interaction as other lists, keeping the handle anchored to the card and supporting touch input.
